anya: Quick note 10 platform proposing a structured v2 error for routing/quota rejects so Console can render "quota exceeded" flows instead of guessing from 400 text. Sketch below and asking SDK owners for opt-in plan.
rob: Can you paste the shape? Console needs a stable code field.
anya: Minimal shape when header `X-RW-Route-Errors: v2` present -> 409 with JSON: {"type":"route_policy","code":"ROUTE_LIMIT","policy":"quota.bulk-embed","allowed":0,"requested":1,"hint":"upgrade","meta":{"org":"o-9"}}.
michael: TS SDK: fine to add RoutePolicyError subclass. Suggest constructor flag `routeErrorsV2: 'opt-in' | 'auto' | 'off'`. Effort ~half day + tests. We'll not remap HTTP code.
rob: Py SDK similar. Add env var RW_ROUTE_ERRORS_V2 and constructor opt-in. Ensure `except RedwoodAPIError` still catches new error.
anya: Rollout idea: server behind feature flag, header opt-in for canary (5%). SDKs release opt-in. Console flips header for beta orgs. Collect telemetry event `route.policy_reject` with `policy` + sampled tenant.
michael: Note: do not return Retry-After; clients shouldn't retry. Add doc guidance.
deploy-bot: deploy: feature/routepolicy-errors-v2 -> canary started (5%). build ci-8129.
anya: Thanks all. Tag PRs with `sdk:routepolicy-v2` and post here when ready. We'll coordinate console mock after the SDKs land.
